eval: (() => { game.audio.unlock(); window.__shots = []; game.weapon.onFire = (o, d) => { const f = new o.constructor(); game.engine.camera.getWorldDirection(f); window.__shots.push(+(d.angleTo(f) * 57.2958).toFixed(3)); }; window.__step = (n, dt = 1 / 30) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { game.player.update(dt); game.weapon.update(dt); game.input.endFrame(); } }; window.__fire = () => { game.input.buttonsPressed |= 1; window.__step(1); }; const w = game.weapon; return { mag: w.magazine, state: w.state, fov: game.engine.camera.fov }; })()
label: arma inicial

eval: (() => { __fire(); const w = game.weapon; return { mag: w.magazine, state: w.state, kick: +game.player.viewOffset.x.toFixed(4), audio: game.audio.ready }; })()
label: tiro do quadril

eval: (() => { __step(10); const w = game.weapon; w.updateEffects = () => {}; w.model.flash.visible = true; w.vmFlash.intensity = 1.2; w.worldFlash.intensity = 40; w.worldFlash.position.copy(game.engine.camera.position); return 'clarão congelado'; })()

(() => { __step(40); game.input.buttonsPressed |= 4; __step(12); const w = game.weapon; return { state: w.state, aim: w.aim, fov: +game.engine.camera.fov.toFixed(1), scopeVisivel: !document.querySelector('.hud-scope').hidden, armaVisivel: w.model.group.visible, lookScale: game.player.lookScale }; })()

eval: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { __fire(); if (i < 2) __step(40); } const w = game.weapon; return { mag: w.magazine, state: w.state, recarregandoVisivel: !document.querySelector('.hud-reload').hidden }; })()

eval: (() => { const fired = window.__shots.length; game.input.buttonsPressed |= 1; __step(1); return { disparouDuranteRecarga: window.__shots.length > fired }; })()
